title: NV-CP 65-200 Centrifugal Process Pump
key_sentences: The NV-CP 65-200 is an end-suction, back pull-out pump for clean and slightly contaminated liquids.
The rotating unit can be removed for service without disturbing the pipework or the motor.
The best efficiency point is at 80 m³/h.
Do not run the pump for long periods below 15 m³/h, because the liquid in the casing heats up quickly at low flow.
Pumps with the optional sensor module report their operating data over Modbus RTU.
Register 40004 is reserved and returns zero.

rows: C = cast iron impeller, D = stainless steel impeller

list_items.text: Process water in food and beverage plants
• Back pull-out design: the motor, bearing bracket and impeller come out as one unit.
• Replaceable wear rings on the casing and the impeller restore efficiency after years of service.
• Bearings are greased for life and sized for at least 25,000 operating hours.
• Casing drain and vent connections are tapped G 1/4 as standard.
– Drinking water approval for the EPDM seal version
– Declaration of conformity for machinery and low-voltage equipment

notes: Two-page pump datasheet in Lucida Sans with one code block in Courier New (an INI-style gateway configuration whose blank line and aligned spaces are part of the code) and an inline code span in the ordering example. Header (brand, "Product datasheet") repeats on both pages and is listed once; footer has the document line and page numbers in the form "1 (2)", "2 (2)". "Applications" is a CSS-drawn bullet list set in TWO columns (read column by column). Two captioned key/value tables stand SIDE BY SIDE under "Technical data" ("Hydraulic" left, "Construction" right), read table by table; no header rows. The performance table has row-header cells in its first column and a header row of flow values. The motor table has row-spanning cells ("400 V, 3-phase, 50 Hz" spans three rows, "IE3" spans two), repeated in each covered row. The ordering-code table has NO lines at all; its first row is a bold header. Standards are a TYPED en-dash list. "Design features" (page 1) is a list with TYPED "•" bullets and a hanging indent. The dimensions table has a dark header row and one body row. Section headings are white on teal bands (level 2).
